descriptions.text: Spirit Box. Set Trap. Effect: Roots target in place. Lowers spirit resistance, and a random non-corporeal entity from the area is summoned to the location and will attempt to possess you. Or eat you. Or just melt your face off and put the goo on a spirit corndog or something. Target: Corporeal dumbasses who step on it. That means you. Duration: You will be rooted in place for sixty seconds. If you end up possessed, that's pretty damn permanent.

recap.text: Carl kneels in the fog and examines the nearest of dozens of flashing lights: a Spirit Box, a set trap that roots its target for sixty seconds and summons a non-corporeal entity to possess it. He disarms it and pockets it, but three monsters shuffle out of the fog. Carl casts Tripper, setting off every Spirit Box in town, and thousands of wails rise as an owl the size of a man appears above the second trap.

beats.headline: Dozens in the fog
beats.text: Traps, Anton says. Through the fog dozens of lights flash, all the same kind, a pair straight ahead side by side, while red dots drift toward the party, drawn by Paz. Carl kneels and examines the closest: a Spirit Box, a set trap that roots its target for sixty seconds, lowers spirit resistance and summons a random non-corporeal entity to try to possess it. Possession is pretty damn permanent. He disarms it and takes it into his inventory. There is no time for the second before three monsters shuffle out of the fog.
beats.gist: Carl disarms a Spirit Box, a trap that roots and possesses, and pockets it before three monsters arrive.

beats.headline: Tripper sets them all off
beats.text: Dozens more ghommids come out of the fog, all summoned by Paz's presence, and Carl calls for the saferoom. He casts Tripper, setting off every Spirit Box trap in town. He would rather farm them, but it is too risky to run with them everywhere; Mongo would set one off at any moment. Thousands of wails rise into the night as ghommids are summoned to traps all over. One, an owl the size of a man, pops into existence right in front of Carl above the second trap.
beats.gist: Carl casts Tripper, setting off every Spirit Box trap in town, and an owl ghommid appears.
